delete.description: Unlink Google; sessions started with Google (possibly this one) are signed out.

post.description: Revoke the current session (its access and refresh tokens stop working).
Email a single-use reset link. The response does not reveal whether the account exists.
Set a new password with an emailed token. Signs out every session.
Confirm the user's identity on this session before a sensitive change.
Rotate the refresh token: from the body (mobile) or the cookie (web, CSRF-checked).

Start registration: email a link that activates the chosen password.

The response is the same whether or not the email is registered (existing owners
get a notice instead), and the account work happens after the response. The
account can sign in once the link is opened with the same password.
Confirm the address with the emailed token and the password chosen at registration.
Email a new verification link. The response does not reveal whether one was sent.

Join a workspace with an invitation token (from the emailed or shared link).

404 ``invalid_invitation`` for every unusable token: unknown, expired, revoked,
already used, or sent to a different email address.

get.description: The workspaces the caller belongs to. Empty until they create or join one.

post.description: Create a workspace; the caller becomes its owner.

delete.description: Delete the workspace and everything in it. Owner only; needs a recent sign-in.

post.description:
Invite by email, or without an email to get a shareable link (and QR) token.

The token of a link invitation is returned once, here. This endpoint does not use
``Idempotency-Key`` replay: stored responses would keep the token in plain text.
Leave the workspace. The owner must transfer ownership or delete it instead.

delete.description: Remove a member. Admins remove members; only the owner removes admins.

patch.description: Make a member an admin or a plain member. Owner only; the owner's role never changes.

post.description: Make another member the owner; the caller becomes an admin. Needs a recent sign-in.
